data.title: 黑歌 · 榻榻米间的微醺猫耳舒展
data.description: 和室榻榻米上散落着精美的瓷酒壶，空气中飘着淡淡酒香。黑歌身穿一袭松散的黑色金边和服，衣领低垂露出如雪般白皙的胸口与锁骨。黑色猫耳随微醺的节拍轻轻扇动，修长双尾在身后妖娆摇曳。她半趴在草席上单手托腮，金色猫瞳带着魅惑的笑意，懒洋洋地发出甜软的小猫呼噜声。
data.location: private tatami room with overturned sake cup
data.action: lounging sideways on tatami floor, loose black kimono revealing collarbone and cleavage, black cat ears twitching happily, twin cat tails swaying, sultry playful cat smile
data.lighting: warm amber floor lanterns casting flickering shadows across tatami
data.mood: bewitching feline seduction, playful purring warmth
data.promptProse: Lounging on tatami mats beside an open sake flask, Kuroka wears a loose black kimono slipping over bare shoulders. Her twin cat tails sway lazily as she smiles with irresistible, purring feline charm.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka lounging on tatami in a loose black kimono with twitching cat ears and twin tails.
